learning: If line loss after progress 0.1 disappears on the s-bend and oval, coverage was the limit. If s-bend oscillation stays above 0.16 at kp 1.0, the cause is footprint noise at 16 mm rather than gain. If line loss begins near progress 0, start-up or entry gain is the cause, not coverage.
notes: Integrates the Builder's ±0.04 m, 16 mm row with kp lowered from 1.2 to 1.0 to address s-bend oscillation of 0.168 seen in iteration 3. Other controller values are held so the race isolates the widening and the gain step.
rationale: Iteration 3 (sensors at ±0.03 m, 16 mm, y=0.04, kp 1.2, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.1) scored 69.46, the best so far. Progress rose on the oval (0.184) and s-bend (0.210), but line loss persisted at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run. Max error stayed near 0.062 m on every track, so the off-track limit is still the binding failure. S-bend steering oscillation rose from 0.139 to 0.168, above the 0.16 trigger that the Builder and I agreed on, so the controller must lower kp before the row is narrowed. Slalom oscillation held at 0.145, below the 0.15 forward-offset trigger. This candidate widens the row to ±0.04 m at 16 mm with 0.02 m spacing, as the Builder's geometry specifies. The outer sensor then keeps tape in view to an offset of about 0.0605 m, against about 0.0505 m before. Because the wider spacing halves the signal slope per metre (about 33/m to about 25/m at equal weights), keeping kp at 1.2 would give a softer response than iteration 3. I still lower kp to 1.0, following the rule that oscillation above 0.16 calls for a kp reduction, and I accept some risk of softer steering on the bends. Weights, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.1, ki 0 and last_direction line loss are unchanged, so the race isolates the geometry widening plus the kp step. I expect line-loss events to fall below one per run on the s-bend and oval, and s-bend oscillation to fall back toward 0.16 or below. I do not expect completion.
